subject: general
question: For which purpose is India's fastest and first multi-PetaFlops (OF) supercomputer 'Pratyush' used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Weather forecasting**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pratyush** is India's fastest and first multi-PetaFlops (PF) supercomputer.
 
• It is primarily used for **weather forecasting**.
 
• The supercomputer helps in improving the accuracy of weather predictions, which is crucial for agriculture, disaster management, and other sectors.
 
• Pratyush enhances the capabilities of the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) in forecasting monsoons, cyclones, and other weather phenomena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The name **Pratyush** means 'sun' in Sanskrit, symbolizing the supercomputer's role in illuminating weather patterns.
 
• India's investment in supercomputing aims to place the country among the top nations in weather and climate modeling.
 
• Pratyush's computational power supports various research and operational activities in atmospheric and oceanic sciences.
 
• Such advancements contribute to better preparedness and mitigation strategies for natural disasters.
